headline.text: L3 ML4 TG3 was down the *entire first shift* — no production after running overnight issues.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 recovered from a gasket contamination that forced a 2-hour drain and re-cook cycle, then cleared belt tracking and white-powder issues. Sollich 3 replaced a pecan flap and resolved a metal fragment find. MM8 outfeed belt still against the wall.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 removed four rolls of film with insufficient glue — two during second shift, two more at end of first shift. FFS long sealer heating pad came off twice but was secured. Speed/sensor issue on FFS remains open.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 TG3 was out of service the entire first shift after overnight gasket issues. ML1 cleared multiple Cavanna infeeder and belt problems. Truffle Line has buildup needing reheat and a broken wire mesh. Metal found on sweco screen under investigation.

notes.text: Rose Smuin coordinating with Culligan on water jug shortage and addressing bikes blocking emergency exit.
Theegarten arriving Monday 9/14 to launch FEA 12g bars on ML2 — two days of programming and setup planned.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 gasket contamination forced drain and re-cook
resolved.summary: Gasket pieces found in caramel at 11:28; all caramel drained, kettles cleaned, and fresh batch cooked — line restarted at 13:46, down approximately 2 hours.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:46 — "We've started running the line" after drain, clean, and re-cook (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 conbar scraper buildup causing soft caramel
resolved.summary: Scraper on second drum conbar had heavy buildup preventing proper caramel contact; cleaned, reinstalled, and line restarted after 15–20 minute pause.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:31 — "Line is back up and running" after scraper clean and reinstall (Nathan Topham).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 return belt #2 tracking and white powder
resolved.summary: Belt shifted and rubbed against door, generating white powder; maintenance re-tracked belt, area cleaned, ATP test performed and passed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:24 — "Line running now" after maintenance adjusted tracking and ATP passed (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 pecan bed flap replacement for piece-count control
resolved.summary: Running out bed and hopper at 07:23 to replace flap for better pecan distribution; new flap installed, adjustments made to achieve target 9 pieces per pouch by 09:42.
resolved.resolution: Resolved at 09:42 — weight 186.5g, 9 pieces achieved after flap install and adjustments (S3 Pack).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 screw with washer found on M6 pass belt
resolved.summary: Hardware fell to floor during production; source identified as C11 belt cover, no metal detected in pouches by X-ray.
resolved.resolution: Source identified at 08:47 — "it's from a cover on the C11 belt" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 metal fragment in chocolate coating
resolved.summary: Magnetic metal fragment found inside chocolate coating during detector verification at 10:51; maintenance investigating source.
resolved.resolution: Investigation underway at 11:03 — "involving maintenance right now," confirmed magnetic (Nathan Topham).

resolved.title: ML2 flow-wrap film with insufficient glue
resolved.summary: Film seals opening due to inadequate glue on two rolls during second shift (19:52–20:30), rolls swapped; two additional bad rolls removed at 10:31 on first shift and saved for supplier review.
resolved.resolution: First issue cleared at 20:30 — "changed and we are running better" (Brandon Lance). Additional rolls removed 10:31 and samples saved for Ethan Bean (Alan Todd).

resolved.title: FFS long sealer heating pad came off twice
resolved.summary: Heating pad detached at 20:48, maintenance fixed, then came off again; secured by 21:06 and running.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:06 — "Line is running" after second fix (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML3 video jet printer sensor calibration
resolved.summary: Video jet printer issue at 14:21; maintenance calibrated sensors and line resumed within 3 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:24 — "Line is running again" after sensor calibration (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML3 film stuck and broken during roll change
resolved.summary: Film got stuck and broke during automatic roll changeover at 14:51; cleared in 4 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:55 — "Line running again" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML2 accidental E-stop on gameboy
resolved.summary: Someone bumped the emergency stop on gameboy controller, stopping line briefly at 07:33.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:40 — "Line is back up. Someone accidentally bumped the E-stop" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML1 Cavanna infeeder rails loose with chocolate buildup
resolved.summary: Bars misaligning at Cavanna infeeder starting 19:50, causing 20-minute stop; loose rails discovered with chocolate buildup underneath, cleaned and secured by maintenance at 21:57.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:57 — "Problem was fixed by maintenance" after cleaning buildup and securing rails (Bojana McLeod).

resolved.title: ML4 TG4 gasket shifted out of position
resolved.summary: Gasket on TG4 moved during third shift (reported 03:10), maintenance worked overnight; TG4 and TG5 running without issues by 06:00.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:00 — "TG 4,5 are currently running without issues" (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt alarm 15 triggering and sensor adjustments
resolved.summary: Alarm 15 triggered frequently starting 09:27 due to belt movement; maintenance adjusted belt tracking and sensors WB100A/WB100B, centered and running well by 10:59.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:59 — "The C6 belt is centered and running well at this time" (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt too high on top pass
resolved.summary: C6 liner belt too high at 00:19, causing line stop; maintenance lowered belt and line restarted within 7 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:26 — "Top belt was too high maintenance lowered the belt line is back running" (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt drifting south, liner needing adjustment
resolved.summary: C6 belt moving south at 03:06, maintenance adjusting belt and liner; back up and running at 03:26.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:26 — "Maintenance is still working on c6 liner belt needs adjusting 0315 back up" (Imperial).

resolved.title: L3 water jugs out of stock
resolved.summary: Out of water jugs at 05:09; Rose Smuin committed to calling Culligan same morning.
resolved.resolution: Action committed at 05:41 — "I will call Culligan this morning" (Rose Smuin).

resolved.title: ML1 C7 belt issue on Cavanna
resolved.summary: C7 belt problem at 06:04, maintenance called; cleared within 26 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 06:30 shown in shift-end summary posted at 06:30 (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

resolved.title: Bikes blocking emergency exit
resolved.summary: Bikes in building blocking emergency exit and path at 08:16; Rose committed to speak with employees that day.
resolved.resolution: Action committed at 08:24 — "I will speak with the employees about the bikes today" (Rose Smuin).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 MM8 outfeed belt against the wall
needs_attention.summary: MM8 multihead outfeed belt is pressed against the wall, reported at 21:37 by Caleb York.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 21:37 on third shift. No follow-up or resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS machine speed stuck at 63–70 despite 87 setting
needs_attention.summary: FFS set for 87 bags/min but only running 63–70; possible sensor problem, maintenance called to investigate at 14:25.
needs_attention.status: Issue reported at 14:25, maintenance called. No resolution or follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG3 down entire first shift after overnight issues
needs_attention.summary: TG3 has been out of service since third shift with packaging coming out open; maintenance worked overnight but line did not run at all during first shift (06:00–14:00).
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working since third shift, briefly attempted restart but went out again. Shawn Jewkes confirmed at 10:42 TG3 "has not run this shift at all." Rose requesting TG support at 11:01.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line enrober heavy buildup requiring reheat
needs_attention.summary: Both enrobers showing large buildup at 04:22 requiring a reheat cycle to clear; no timeline or completion posted.
needs_attention.status: Large buildup documented at 04:22 with photos. No follow-up on reheat completion by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line bottomer wire mesh broken at corner
needs_attention.summary: Wire mesh on bottomer broken at one corner at 06:39; concern it could get caught in detailer and break completely, Nelson Cook asked to repair.
needs_attention.status: Reported to Nelson Cook and leadership at 06:56. No repair completion posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C6 rails accumulating chocolate, sensors not rejecting
needs_attention.summary: Cannot increase speed at 07:21 because chocolate accumulating on rails and C6 sensors not rejecting incorrectly positioned product; maintenance called to check.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 07:21, new centerline (Cavanna 8.5g) provided by Shawn at 07:51. No clear resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 metal piece found on sweco screen during shift
needs_attention.summary: Metal piece discovered on southwest side of screen at 10:19 during screen check; caught at sweco so line did not stop, but source investigation in progress.
needs_attention.status: Under investigation as of 10:40, Kevin Del Valle investigating source. Preston Tregaskis keeping close eye and requested updates.

needs_attention.title: Four light fixtures not working in washroom
needs_attention.summary: Four light fixtures out in L3 washroom at 07:01; Nelson Cook asked to inspect and repair.
needs_attention.status: Nelson asked to look at 07:01. No completion update by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line M4 belt alarm triggered
needs_attention.summary: M4 belt alarm went off at 10:29, maintenance notified; no resolution or follow-up posted.
needs_attention.status: Alarm triggered at 10:29, maintenance notified. No update by window close at 11:10.
